items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: In the meantime I had to make some money so I joined Frankie Carle’s band.

ctx.x: Yes. Did the prospect of the draft frighten you?

Well it did. Actually I’ll take a minute and a half and tell you this story. I’m trying to think of the timeframe. I went to City College actually because I wanted to go to City College, but probably a lesser reason was that the Korean War was going on then too and I really didn’t want to go for that. So I couldn’t just go to City College and take music. You had to prepare for a teacher’s credential to make it legitimate. So to do that I had to take a lot of subjects that I had had a bellyful of in high school…
